manifest._rule: §5h: counts are asserted against contents at seal time by tests/sealed_manifests.rs. A description disagreeing with this block is a seal failure.

expectation_schema.passed: integer or null — null means the format reports an outcome but no count
expectation_schema.must_abstain: true when the ONLY correct answer is Unknown; a parse here is a misclassification and fails the gate

gate: ≥70% of non-trap cases correctly classified; ZERO misclassifications across all cases (a trap that parses, or any wrong count, is a failure). Abstention on a non-trap case costs coverage, never correctness.
